category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response fully commits to strength-of-schedule theology, stressing weekly attrition, line play ("elite defensive fronts"), and quality wins versus ranked opponents; it is unapologetic and argues selection over record. quote: A 9-3 record in the SEC can represent a résumé forged through the toughest weekly environment in college football: elite defensive fronts, NFL-caliber skill talent, hostile road venues, and minimal “off weeks.”
